quest.title: Windrise, Windfall
quest.description: The recent storms have been affecting business at Dawn Winery, so Elzer is trying his best to come up with ideas to get things back in order...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x8

talks.objective: Clear the main road of any monsters and obstacles

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: Wonderful. Thank you for your willingness to assist. I have marked the three merchant routes on your map. Please help us out.

talks.objective: Clear the main road of any monsters and obstacles
Clear the main road of any monsters and obstacles

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: Have you cleared the merchant roads out?

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: That's great. Our winery's business can gradually resume now.

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: Honestly, I should have reported this matter to Master Diluc...

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: But he's upped and disappeared. I've searched high and low for him all over the winery, but no one knows where he's gone.

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: Adelinde said something like "Master Diluc has gone to attend to a personal matter," but refused to say anything more. She didn't even look worried.

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: *sigh* Forget it. Once he's back, I will have a good talk with him...

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: If our winery's business remains closed for any longer, how will I face Master Diluc...

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: Traveler, if you meet Master Diluc, could you tell him about this?

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: It just won't do, the way he just leaves the winery to its own devices all the time.
